how to use: A browser that has run a notebook keeps its own copy and goes on showing it, also after the
notebook on the site has been corrected. To make a correction reach every student, give the
notebook a higher revision here and build the site again: it is then published under a new
file name (..._r2.ipynb), every link to it is updated, and the home page says what changed.
The student's earlier copy, with the answers typed in it, stays in the browser under the old name.
Do this only for corrections that matter (a wrong formula, a broken exercise): the corrected
notebook opens clean, without the answers the student had typed.
Example of an entry of "notebooks" (the key is the first part of the file name):
"10": {"revision": 2, "date": "2027-02-03", "note": "Exercise 2(b): the sign of the answer was wrong."}
